calendarFaqs.q: Which Durham Public Schools calendar should families use?
calendarFaqs.a: Most DPS students follow the traditional calendar shown on this page. Students at year-round schools use a separate calendar, so those families should use the matching official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Does DPS have early release days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The DPS traditional calendar lists early release days on October 20 and December 8, 2027, and February 23, May 10, and June 7, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Are teacher workdays no-school days for DPS students?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Teacher workdays and required teacher workdays listed on the traditional student calendar are no-school days for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I check for last-minute DPS calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official DPS 2027–28 calendar page and announcements from your student's school. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and does not automatically receive district changes.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2026–27
content: School starts one day earlier, on August 23 instead of August 24.
The last day moves two days earlier, from June 9 to June 7.
Spring break is two days earlier, moving from March 22–26 to March 20–24.
The traditional calendar includes five student early release days.
